data.text: Can you research for an option of execution that ddflow shall support where several tasks or bugs are implemented in parallel and then they wait for the common roborev and other gates to be checked based on the size of the changes (so review, critic per X changed lines) so we can speed up the development and make the gates and review steps more rare and supposedly faster? Is this make sense? Can you research for such an option? Check also what we plan to implement and what core code we can reuse. Research over internet and by yourself what are the best practices and make a proposal

data.body: Operator 2026-10-22 asked for research on a batch execution mode. Output: research doc, decision proposals, queued P-batch-gates.
data.title: Research: batched gates (ci, review, critic by changed lines) across parallel items; options, reuse, proposal
